remarks: A truly rare opportunity to live on one of the most picturesque and coveted cul-de-sacs in Brentwood Glen. Tucked away in an exceptionally peaceful setting, away from the freeway, this enchanting four-bedroom, three-bathroom residence offers the perfect blend of timeless charm, privacy, and effortless California living. Beautifully updated throughout, the home features a thoughtfully renovated kitchen, updated bathrooms, and inviting living spaces filled with warmth and character. The versatile floor plan includes three bedrooms on the main level and an expansive upstairs bedroom, offering wonderful flexibility for a variety of lifestyles.
